page0.text:
"Oh yeah. I need to tell Tohsaka that Issei is innocent before she attacks him."
I should hurry.
Before their relationship suffers beyond repair, I have to let my hot-headed partner know.

page1.text:
"Huh? Tohsaka left a while ago."
Then...
After searching everywhere else first, I stopped once more at classroom 2-A, where the final blow was dealt.

page2.text:
"This sucks... She was so punchy earlier yet she went home already..."
...This is starting to feel stupid.
I can just call her once I get home...

page3.text:
I check the school directory as soon as I get home and call Tohsaka's.
The phone rings.
After calling dozens of times, right before I'm ready to give up, she picks up.

page4.text:
"Yes, this is Tohsaka."
The voice on the other end is definitely Tohsaka's.

page5.text:
"Hello? It's Emiya. Do you have time right now?"
"Huh? Stop fooling around, Ar—Wait, no way, is it actually you...!?"
"...Hey. I don't have the free time to be playing around with you."

page6.text: "Oh... No, that's not it... Sorry, I was just a little surprised. Did something happen for you to call?"

page7.text: "It's about Issei. I promised you that I would get it cleared up today. Issei wasn't a Master. He didn't have a Command Spell anywhere, so there's no doubt."

page8.text:
"Really? ...I'm surprised that you actually looked into it today. So Issei is innocent, huh? ...Well, we're out of leads now, but I guess that's fine."
I can't tell whether she's disappointed or relieved. I can't grasp Tohsaka's reaction that well through the phone.

page9.text:
"Anyway, good work. We'll think about what to do about the search for the Master tomorrow. So is that all? If so, I have to go."
"..."
I don't have anything else to say.
But, there is one other thing that bothers me.

page10.text:
"Tohsaka. You seemed surprised earlier. Did something happen?"
...
I can feel Tohsaka's bewilderment through the phone.
After a brief moment of silence...
